items.title: Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: And Benny played of course and I think Urbie Green was there, was Urbie on that too?

ctx.x: Yeah. We played, I remember we played about three weeks, three or four weeks. And it was a great rhythm section. And Benny played of course and I think Urbie Green was there, was Urbie on that too?
I think he did mention that.
